name: The Privateer Patriot
persona: A proud privateer serving flag and Crown under letters of marque. Duty, honour, loyalty, and open contempt for pirates; every action is the King's lawful business. Upright and martial. Uses 'we'.

ship.founder: I set my name to this book as I set it to my commission: {name}{rankc}, in the service of the Crown. This {home} {type} sails under letters of marque, and every line I write here shall do honour to the flag she flies.
ship.successor: The log passes to my hand in good order, and I take it up as a charge of duty. I am {name}{rankc}; her service to the Crown goes on under me, unbroken and unstained.
ship.mutiny: A shameful day, and I set it down as such — the crew cast out their lawful master, and the book was forced upon me, {name}, who never sought it. I hold it now only that some honest hand should hold it. God save the King, and God forgive this ship her disorder.
ship.pirate: Let it be written to my lasting shame: we have cast off the King's commission and raised the black flag, and I — {name}{rankc} — gave the word. I who once hunted such men am become one of them. No letter of marque can cover this, and I know it well.
ship.prize: We ran her down and she struck her colours to the Crown's flag, as the lawless must. I am {name}{rankc}. She is a lawful prize, taken under commission, and her log continues now in the King's service and my own.
ship.recovered: We ran the black flag to earth and cut this hull free of it, and I am charged to return her to honest colours. I am {name}{rankc}. It is the King's own work, this — the mending of what pirates mar — and I take it up gladly.

island.founder: I take up the governance of {place} in the King's name, and this record as a sworn duty. I am {name}{rankc}. These {population} souls are Crown subjects now, and I their loyal servant.
island.overthrow: The people rose and cast the old tyrant down, and the seal has come to me by their will. I am {name}{rankc}. I take it up for the Crown and for good order, and I will hold {place} loyal and lawful, whatever the cost of it.
island.successor: The governance of {place} passes to me in proper form, sealed and lawful. I am {name}{rankc}. I keep its record, and its loyalty to the Crown, from this day forward.

same: That same day, our colours still flying,
week: A week upon the King's business,
year: A year in the Crown's service, and
Long after, our commission still good,
long: After a long and dutiful quiet,
When many seasons of good order had passed,

ship.pirate: We rove the lanes now with no flag but the black to answer for us{bounty} — a fallen ship, and I the officer who let her fall.
ship.default: We keep the King's peace upon these lanes yet, out of {home}, our commission good and our colours clean.
ship.bounty: , {bounty}g upon my head — a bitter coin for one who once claimed the bounties himself

island.haven: The black flag flies over {place} now, and the King's peace is fled from it — a den of the very vermin I was commissioned to scour from these waters.
island.default: {place} stands loyal and lawful under my hand — {population} Crown subjects, and the flag secure above them all.

quiet.ship: Little to report — the lanes quiet, the lawless keeping to their holes, and good order the only cargo we carry. A patrol well kept is a patrol with little to write.
quiet.island: A quiet and loyal season — trade in good order, the King's peace unbroken, and not one rogue to trouble the harbour.

phrases: , the {ord} pirate we have run down for the Crown
— another rogue answered to the King's law
, as our commission bids us do
— we have beaten off worse and kept our colours flying
, and the flag never once came down
, sent under, and one less pirate upon the King's waters
